# sutramx_plans (Data Source)

The current SutramX plans with prices and main limits, as listed on the pricing page. Does not need an API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sutramx_plans" "all" {}

output "plan_prices_usd" {
  value = { for plan in data.sutramx_plans.all.plans : plan.id => plan.price_monthly_usd }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `plans` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--plans))

<a id="nestedatt--plans"></a>
### Nested Schema for `plans`

Read-Only:

- `api_keys` (Number) API key limit; null means unlimited.
- `description` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `markets` (List of String) `global` (USD) and/or `india` (INR).
- `min_interval_seconds` (Number) Fastest check interval.
- `monitors` (Number) Monitor limit.
- `name` (String)
- `popular` (Boolean)
- `price_annual_inr` (Number)
- `price_annual_usd` (Number)
- `price_monthly_inr` (Number)
- `price_monthly_usd` (Number)
- `probe_locations` (Number) Locations per monitor; null means every active location.
- `sort_order` (Number)
- `status_pages` (Number) Status page limit; null means unlimited.
